column1: # Checked in before the code it covers. Anchors: the Phase 4 entry captures (rev 46; final
# view, TAA without jitter, each scene's Phase 1b TAA settled tier, 64 frames, seeds 0 and 1).
# RLT-IBL-011 (light-loop specular in the non-/pi diffuse convention): sized on an uncommitted
# spike of exactly this change (specular x pi in include/lighting.glsl, both triangle.frag
# variants rebuilt), 2026-11-21. Brighter only. One entry per tile the spike moved beyond
# tolerance; expected = the larger of the tile's mean and p95 change, tolerance 25 % of it + 0.02.
# The other Phase 4 mechanisms are declared before their own commits.
# RLT-IBL-001...004 and RLT-IBL-010 (rev 48), on top of RLT-IBL-011: sized on an uncommitted spike of
# exactly this code (split-sum environment specular from include/env_brdf_lut.glsl, the probe mip above
# roughness 0.6, specular occlusion of the probe share, exterior dielectrics on the probe, the probe baked
# without the sun disc), 2026-11-21, against the Phase 4 anchors. One entry per tile the combined change
# moves beyond the RLT-IBL-011 entries; direction measured, expected = the larger of |mean| and p95.
# RLT-IBL-006 (portal-sky GI escape, Show Sky and bounded-aperture interiors; rev 48): measured on an uncommitted
# spike of exactly this code together with the entries above, 2026-11-21: no Phase 4 anchor scene is a Show Sky or
# bounded-aperture interior, and the spike's A11 against the Phase 4 anchors under this declaration reads 0 tiles
# outside on Cornell, Prospector, MedTek and Dugout and 1 on Whiterun, a tile that differs between two captures of
# identical code (14,17 in one run, 37,20 in the next: process-to-process scene variance). No entries are added.
# RLT-IBL-004 traced lobe visibility (rev 49, owner), checked in before its code: no entries. Sized on an
# uncommitted spike of exactly this code (on an exterior, the sky probe share occluded by one TLAS ray per pixel
# drawn from the visible-normal GGX lobe instead of SSAO's Lagarde form), 2026-11-22, against the Phase 4 anchors.
# The mechanism runs on exteriors only, and every A11 scene is an interior or the Cornell room (the Whiterun
# scene is the Bannered Mare), so it moves no anchor tile. The two tiles the spike capture puts at the tolerance
# edge (Dugout 4,18 and Whiterun 37,20) read the same, to four digits, in the rev 48 build's capture: they are
# not this change. Its content effect is measured by A6's contact-sky rows instead.
